$112.5\text{ lb}$ at $35.7^\circ$ down and to the left

questions.question: If $P = 75\text{ N}$ and $Q = 125\text{ N}$, determine the magnitude of the resultant force at point A.
questions.situation_text: Two forces P and Q are applied at point A of a hook support. Force P is directed $20^\circ$ to the left of the downward vertical, and force Q is directed $35^\circ$ to the right of the downward vertical.
